en: This is a vintage, colorized postcard showing a crowded beach scene with people dressed in early 20th-century European clothing. The beach is lively, with groups sitting on benches and walking along the sand. There are boats and a beach hut visible, with a hillside in the background. The text at the top reads 'Lourenço Marques', 'Na praia da Polana', and 'On Polana Beach.'
